rule_statistics.label: typhoid
rule_statistics.description: Matches texts describing a combination of at least one core GI symptom (vomiting, nausea, diarrhea, constipation) and at least one systemic symptom or abdominal pain (fever, headache, abdominal/stomach pain).

examples_true_positive.text: i've lost a lot of weight in the last week because i couldn't eat much due to nausea and vomiting. this is followed by a high fever, headache, and stomach pain.
i've had a lot of bloating and constipation, which has been really painful. there is a lot of pressure and pain in my stomach area. i get a high fever and chills every night.
most of the time i feel fatigued. i don't want to eat anything. i get a high fever and chills every night. moreover, i have been vomiting since yesterday.
i've had a persistent headache for the past week, and it's been getting worse. it's been accompanied by belly aches, constipation and diarrhea.
i am experiencing extreme belly pain and constipation. every night, i have a severe fever along with chills and headaches. the last couple of days has been really uncomfortable.
i've also been experiencing some diarrhea and constipation, which has been really worrying. it feels like a sharp, stabbing pain in my belly area. i feel tired all the time.

rule_statistics.label: varicose veins
rule_statistics.description: Matches direct mentions of veins or blood vessels being prominent, swollen, visible, or protruding on legs or calves.

examples_true_positive.text: my veins of legs have become more visible and swollen than normal. they are visible through my skin and it hurts when i move.
the veins on my legs are very noticeable and are causing me a lot of discomforts. they are swollen and protrude from my skin, making them visible through my clothing.
the veins on my legs are causing a lot of discomforts when i sit for long periods of time. they are swollen and protruding from my skin, making them painful and noticeable.
the skin around the veins on my legs is red and inflamed. i believe i can see some of the swollen blood vessels. i am really worried about it.

rule_statistics.label: chicken pox
rule_statistics.description: Matches combinations of general systemic symptoms characteristic of chicken pox, such as fever/headache, fatigue/weakness, and loss of appetite, requiring at least two distinct categories of these symptoms.

examples_true_positive.text: i've had a mild fever for the past few days, and it's starting to worry me. the fever has been accompanied by a severe headache. i feel weak and lethargic.
the itching is making it hard for me to sleep at night. i can't get any rest. i have also lost my appetite and feel lethargic.

rule_statistics.label: chicken pox
rule_statistics.description: Identifies explicit mentions of 'red spots', 'patches', or 'rashes' combined with any general systemic symptom or itching, as these are strong indicators not present in counter-examples. Priority increased to resolve conflict with typhoid.

examples_true_positive.text: i have red spots on my arms and legs and itching them makes it difficult for me to sleep at night. i also have severe headaches and a mild fever.
i have swollen lymph nodes and red spots all over my body, and they are causing discomfort. i also have a mild fever and feel tired most of the time.
there are small red spots all over my body. the spots are itchy and uncomfortable. i also have a mild fever and headache.
